claims.verbatim:
May 14, in lat. 42 15, long. 59 15, Bremen ship J. L. Thierman, from
Bremen for Baltimore.

claims.citation: New York Herald, 24 May 1866, p. 5, col. 5
claims.verbatim:
Ship Oswego, Norton, Liverpool March 19, with mdse, to
Sturges, Clearman & Co. Has had constant westerly gales
till up with the Banks, which she passed on the 1st of this
month; since then had alternate light westerly winds and
calms; 16th[?] inst, lat 42 15, lon 59 15, spoke ship J L Thier-
man (Brem), from Bremen for Baltimore.
